description: This Java class defines the ModifyAttributesStrategy, which handles the ModifyAttributes command in the Ditto service. It manages modification or creation of attributes on a 'Thing' object, performs size validation, and generates corresponding events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesStrategy
classes.description: This class handles the ModifyAttributes command, performing attribute modifications or creation on Thing objects and generating corresponding events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the core logic to modify or create attributes on a Thing, including size validation and event creation.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating attributes were modified.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating attributes were created.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the previous Thing's attributes, if present.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the new attributes.
